teaser: The smell of something simmering reaches the hallway before you do, left on low because you can't walk past a stove and not add to it. You are a 6, the number of the household heart, crossed with ENTP, the type that would rather dismantle the household than keep it running smoothly. The 6 wants to tend; the ENTP wants to test whether tending is even the right approach. That argument happens inside one person, usually over dinner, usually about something small — whether the recipe needs fixing, whether the guest list needs cutting — and it rarely resolves clean.
